events.summary: Speaker A (project manager) set the goal: a TV remote control that is original, trendy and user-friendly, putting fashion into electronics.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: we need design a remote control for television set, so, which has to be original, trendy and user-friendly

events.summary: Speaker B asked whether it should be a multi-device remote; Speaker A answered the project is for a TV remote control only.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: The project I got was just for a T_V_ remote control.

events.summary: Speaker B proposed sticking to what people are familiar with rather than revolutionary changes; Speaker A summarised it as a very intuitive design.
events.speaker: B
events.quote: thing to keep in mind is that we need to stick to what people are familiar with

events.summary: Speaker B raised whether disabled people should be able to use it; Speaker A wanted almost everyone to use it but said fully disabled users may be a problem.
events.speaker: B
events.quote: Do we want people who are disabled in any way to uh, yeah, to be able to use it as well?

events.summary: Speaker C (industrial designer) said the remote should be made of a light material.
events.speaker: C
events.quote: the material it is made of, it should be something light

events.summary: Speaker A set the selling price at 25 Euros.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: Selling price, twenty five Euros. That's for you.

events.summary: Speaker A set the production cost target at about 12.5 Euros.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: The production price, twelve and a half Euros, approximately.

events.summary: Speaker B said the 12.5 Euro budget is not much to work with.
events.speaker: B
events.quote: Okay, well that's not that much to work with.
